Req. 1.title: Bidirectional Requirement Traceability Matrix (RTM)
Req. 1.normative_statement: The Contractor shall maintain an automated RTM linking all clause IDs to acceptance tests.

Req. 2.title: Zero-Prescription Architecture
Req. 2.normative_statement: The Technical Addendum shall define 'WHAT' is required while minimizing prescriptive 'HOW' constraints.
